input.prompt: Create ONE radically re-staged 16:9 cinematic anime storyboard impact frame. Dramatic foreground leader occupies lower RIGHT third, side-back three-quarter silhouette, knees bent in staggered standing brace (not kneeling), both forearms raised to sustain shield, head tilted upward, face only slim profile; do not require complete body or a portrait. Single huge rounded gold translucent defense shield curves above/in front of him. GIANT water dragon sweeps from upper LEFT down to lower RIGHT, its strongly foreshortened head fills upper left and middle, long thick neck recedes upward out of frame. Preserve recognizable one blue eye/brow/neck ABOVE contact, not a roaring open mouth. Dark smooth translucent blue volumes and thick liquid undersides, white foam concentrated at contact not uniform speckles. Force pulls cloak backwards, loose cloth arcs to lower right. Lower frame has two foamy lateral streams rushing away along stone steps and one or two small black-gold cultists swept off balance at edges, not airborne corpses. The lower central landing remains legible. Narrow cathedral pillars and intact side stained-glass recede behind water, deep shadows to make the contact stand out. GPT and the far upper altar/friendly dark dome are OUT OF FRAME, don't squeeze them in; still no friendly injury or shield clash. No explosions/fire, lightning, blood, extra dragons, magic portals, text or borders. A visceral ground-level enemy's pressure viewpoint with near/far depth and hierarchy, not a wide architectural diagram. Keep original anime cast/design and blue-gold colors.
